sources.title: Best LLM for OCR (2026): GLM-OCR Wins at 94.62 - ofox.ai
sources.snippet: Which AI model has the best OCR accuracy in 2026? On the OmniDocBench benchmark, specialized models lead: GLM-OCR scores 94.62 and PaddleOCR-VL hits 94.50. Among frontier LLMs, Gemini 3.1 Pro leads at 90.33, ahead of GPT-5.4 at roughly 85.8. The best choice depends on your use case — frontier LLMs handle reasoning alongside extraction, while specialized models maximize raw accuracy.
